units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|Shortly after entering the spaceport, you observe an Arach in what you guess is a formal "dress," a delicate silk wrap covering most of her body with each leg covered by its own embroidered skirt. She exclaims something loudly into a personal communication device before putting it away with a shove. Like everyone else who has momentarily been witness to this, you go to look away, but the Arach has cast their gaze around, seen you, and immediately begun to approach. "Our honorable human visitor, I salute," she says loudly as she closes the gap. "Say, Captain, appreciate the fine arts, do you? To a cultural soiree, I'm headed, but busy with work, dearest Papa is, so vacant, his reserved seat is. Accompany me, would you?"|81|0
units.english: Shortly after entering the spaceport, you observe an Arach in what you guess is a formal "dress," a delicate silk wrap covering most of her body with each leg covered by its own embroidered skirt. She exclaims something loudly into a personal communication device before putting it away with a shove. Like everyone else who has momentarily been witness to this, you go to look away, but the Arach has cast their gaze around, seen you, and immediately begun to approach. "Our honorable human visitor, I salute," she says loudly as she closes the gap. "Say, Captain, appreciate the fine arts, do you? To a cultural soiree, I'm headed, but busy with work, dearest Papa is, so vacant, his reserved seat is. Accompany me, would you?"
units.italian: Poco dopo il vostro ingresso nello spazioporto, notate un'Arach in quello che immaginate essere un "abito" formale: un delicato drappo di seta che le copre gran parte del corpo, con ogni zampa avvolta in una gonna ricamata. Grida qualcosa a voce alta in un dispositivo di comunicazione personale, poi lo ripone con uno scatto. Come tutti quelli che l'hanno vista per un istante, cercate di distogliere lo sguardo, ma l'Arach si è già guardata intorno, vi ha visti e si è subito avvicinata. "Nostro onorevole visitatore umano, saluto", dice a voce alta mentre colma la distanza. "Dica, Capitano, apprezzate le belle arti, voi? A una serata culturale sono diretta, ma occupato dal lavoro il mio caro papà è, quindi vuoto il suo posto riservato è. Mi accompagnate, volete?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	"Is that some sort of event?"|83|0
units.english: "Is that some sort of event?"
units.italian: "Di che evento si tratta?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	"I'm busy right now, so I'll pass."|84|0
units.english: "I'm busy right now, so I'll pass."
units.italian: "In questo momento ho da fare, quindi passo."

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	"No simple gathering, but a collection of plays by esteemed professionals, completed by a dedicated orchestra, the soiree is," she explains. "A celebration of Arach folklore, it is, which in our finest outfits, us local patrons attend. Streamed live for others, the show also is, but compare to the live performance, it cannot."|86|0
units.english: "No simple gathering, but a collection of plays by esteemed professionals, completed by a dedicated orchestra, the soiree is," she explains. "A celebration of Arach folklore, it is, which in our finest outfits, us local patrons attend. Streamed live for others, the show also is, but compare to the live performance, it cannot."
units.italian: "Non un semplice ritrovo, ma una raccolta di opere di professionisti stimati, completata da un'orchestra dedicata, la serata è", spiega. "Una celebrazione del folklore Arach, è, a cui nei nostri abiti migliori noi patroni locali partecipiamo. Trasmesso in diretta per gli altri, lo spettacolo è anche, ma paragonarsi all'esecuzione dal vivo, non può."

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	"Alright, I'm interested. Where is this 'soiree' taking place?"|88|0
units.english: "Alright, I'm interested. Where is this 'soiree' taking place?"
units.italian: "Va bene, mi interessa. Dove si tiene questa 'serata'?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	"I'm not a fan of plays, sorry."|89|0
units.english: "I'm not a fan of plays, sorry."
units.italian: "Il teatro non mi appassiona, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	You follow her around the central portion of the city to a building which from the outside looks like some form of auditorium; there, some Arachi in uniform are seeing to the entries of the "patrons" of the event. "A human? Quite an exotic guest you've brought, lady Matlub," one of them says to your guide as she shows him a touchpad displaying two tickets. He verifies them and allows the two of you to enter. The inside reminds you of an opera house, with a large stage in front of dozens of rows of seats, and six levels of balconies on both sides. Matlub leads you to two excellent seats in one of the first few rows, and she helps you "adjust" the chair so that you're more comfortably seated. Just before the stage is an area a few steps below the level of the seats, with a few Arach musicians fine-tuning a variety of instruments. Up on the ceiling, and on all of the balconies, you see small cameras pointed at the stage to broadcast the event for those who didn't have the chance to attend it live.|91|0

Just before the stage is an area a few steps below the level of the seats, with a few Arach musicians fine-tuning a variety of instruments. units.italian: La seguite attraverso la parte centrale della città fino a un edificio che dall'esterno sembra una specie di auditorium; lì alcuni Arachi in uniforme controllano gli ingressi dei "patroni" dell'evento. "Un umano? Un ospite piuttosto esotico, avete portato, signora Matlub", dice uno di loro alla vostra guida mentre lei gli mostra un touchpad con due biglietti. Lui li verifica e vi lascia entrare. L'interno vi ricorda un teatro d'opera: un grande palco davanti a decine di file di poltrone e sei ordini di balconate su entrambi i lati. Matlub vi conduce a due ottimi posti in una delle prime file e vi aiuta a "regolare" la poltrona perché stiate più comodi. Subito davanti al palco c'è una zona qualche gradino sotto il livello dei posti, con alcuni musicisti Arach che accordano strumenti diversi. Sul soffitto e su tutte le balconate vedete piccole telecamere puntate verso il palco, per trasmettere l'evento a chi non ha potuto assistervi dal vivo.

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	As the rows and balconies fill up with more guests, you notice a few Kimek and Saryds amidst the masses of Arachi, most of them accompanying an Arach patron; a few are seemingly patrons themselves, coming in on their own. A great many of them seem to take notice of you as you look around, but your patron studiously ignores the attention.|92|0
units.english: As the rows and balconies fill up with more guests, you notice a few Kimek and Saryds amidst the masses of Arachi, most of them accompanying an Arach patron; a few are seemingly patrons themselves, coming in on their own. A great many of them seem to take notice of you as you look around, but your patron studiously ignores the attention.
units.italian: Mentre file e balconate si riempiono di altri ospiti, notate qualche Kimek e qualche Saryd fra le masse di Arach; quasi tutti accompagnano un patrone Arach, qualcuno sembra essere a sua volta patrone, entrato da solo. Molti di loro vi notano mentre vi guardate intorno, ma la vostra patrone ignora l'attenzione con studiata indifferenza.

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	"I can see why you were speaking so highly about this, looks like a really organized event."|94|0
units.english: "I can see why you were speaking so highly about this, looks like a really organized event."
units.italian: "Capisco perché ne parlavate con tanto entusiasmo: sembra un evento davvero ben organizzato."

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	"Not every day that they see a human in one of these, I take it?"|95|0
units.english: "Not every day that they see a human in one of these, I take it?"
units.italian: "Non capita tutti i giorni che si veda un umano a una serata così, immagino?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	She nods. "A prestigious event, this is. Bring friends from all around the Coalition to watch, the patrons do. The most unique guest we've had, you are."|96|0
units.english: She nods. "A prestigious event, this is. Bring friends from all around the Coalition to watch, the patrons do. The most unique guest we've had, you are."
units.italian: Annuisce. "Un evento prestigioso, questo è. Portare amici da tutta la Coalizione a vedere, i patroni lo fanno. L'ospite più singolare che abbiamo avuto, voi siete."

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	Once all seats are filled, the doors are closed, and an Arach comes to the stage. "Welcome you, esteemed guests, to this celebration of saga and song, our theater does," he says. "Make you wait any longer, I shall not, so for our first play, a timeless classic dear to all, I present: Moonstruck."|97|0
units.english: Once all seats are filled, the doors are closed, and an Arach comes to the stage. "Welcome you, esteemed guests, to this celebration of saga and song, our theater does," he says. "Make you wait any longer, I shall not, so for our first play, a timeless classic dear to all, I present: Moonstruck."
units.italian: Quando tutti i posti sono occupati, le porte si chiudono e un Arach sale sul palco. "Accogliervi, stimati ospiti, a questa celebrazione di saga e canto, il nostro teatro ha il piacere di", dice. "Farvi aspettare ancora, non voglio, quindi per la nostra prima opera, un classico senza tempo caro a tutti, vi presento: Toccato dalla Luna."

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	He quickly leaves the stage as the curtains open to reveal a rocky wall with two tunnels leading to the sides. The orchestra begins to play a slow, soft theme on accordion-like instruments, and a young Arach comes into the scene from the tunnel on the left. He hangs onto the rocky wall, a small lantern hanging from his abdomen and a large sack strapped to his back. The Arach then picks rocks from the corners of the wall, throwing most to the ground but placing a few inside the sack he carries. Once the sack is full, he enters the tunnel on the right, and the rocky wall is rotated to show the other side; there, the young miner is shown under the night sky smelting the ore he collected. As he looks to the top of the stage with his back facing the audience, the accordions grow quieter, a slow harp starts to play, and a full moon comes into view at the top of the background sky.|98|0
units.english: He quickly leaves the stage as the curtains open to reveal a rocky wall with two tunnels leading to the sides. The orchestra begins to play a slow, soft theme on accordion-like instruments, and a young Arach comes into the scene from the tunnel on the left. He hangs onto the rocky wall, a small lantern hanging from his abdomen and a large sack strapped to his back. The Arach then picks rocks from the corners of the wall, throwing most to the ground but placing a few inside the sack he carries. Once the sack is full, he enters the tunnel on the right, and the rocky wall is rotated to show the other side; there, the young miner is shown under the night sky smelting the ore he collected. As he looks to the top of the stage with his back facing the audience, the accordions grow quieter, a slow harp starts to play, and a full moon comes into view at the top of the background sky.
units.italian: Esce rapidamente di scena mentre il sipario si apre su una parete rocciosa con due gallerie laterali. L'orchestra comincia a suonare un tema lento e dolce su strumenti simili a fisarmoniche, e un giovane Arach entra in scena dalla galleria di sinistra. Si tiene aggrappato alla parete rocciosa, con una piccola lanterna appesa all'addome e un grosso sacco legato sulla schiena. Poi stacca pietre dagli angoli della parete, gettandone la maggior parte a terra ma mettendone alcune nel sacco che porta. Quando il sacco è pieno, entra nella galleria di destra e la parete rocciosa ruota per mostrare l'altro lato; lì il giovane minatore è mostrato sotto il cielo notturno mentre fonde il minerale raccolto. Mentre guarda verso l'alto del palco con la schiena rivolta al pubblico, le fisarmoniche si fanno più sommesse, un'arpa comincia a suonare lentamente e una luna piena compare in cima allo sfondo del cielo.

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	The curtains close as the scene changes, opening again with the accordions picking up the pace. The Arach is now on a larger wall with only one tunnel from above. He claws away at the rocky corners, the accordions following his rhythm. Once he's dug out most of the ore, the wall starts shaking, as if the mine were collapsing. The accordions become erratic as he rushes for the escape tunnel. With a hectic clamor, the rock wall appears to disassemble on stage with great boulders descending gracefully from the fly tower, caving in the mine. The accordions stop, but after a long pause they, along with the harp, slowly pick up again. The young Arach then climbs into view and pushes first one boulder away, and then another, and another. This goes on until the Arach stands atop a mountain of metal carved out of the rock, reaching for the moon. As he nearly touches it, the curtains close and the music stops.|99|0
units.english: The curtains close as the scene changes, opening again with the accordions picking up the pace. The Arach is now on a larger wall with only one tunnel from above. He claws away at the rocky corners, the accordions following his rhythm. Once he's dug out most of the ore, the wall starts shaking, as if the mine were collapsing. The accordions become erratic as he rushes for the escape tunnel. With a hectic clamor, the rock wall appears to disassemble on stage with great boulders descending gracefully from the fly tower, caving in the mine. The accordions stop, but after a long pause they, along with the harp, slowly pick up again. The young Arach then climbs into view and pushes first one boulder away, and then another, and another. This goes on until the Arach stands atop a mountain of metal carved out of the rock, reaching for the moon. As he nearly touches it, the curtains close and the music stops.
units.italian: Il sipario si chiude mentre la scena cambia, e si riapre con le fisarmoniche che accelerano. L'Arach è ora su una parete più grande, con una sola galleria in alto. Graffia via gli angoli rocciosi e le fisarmoniche seguono il suo ritmo. Quando ha estratto quasi tutto il minerale, la parete comincia a tremare, come se la miniera stesse crollando. Le fisarmoniche diventano irregolari mentre lui si precipita verso la galleria di fuga. Con un clamore febbrile, la parete rocciosa sembra smontarsi sul palco: grandi massi scendono con grazia dalla torre scenica e fanno crollare la miniera. Le fisarmoniche tacciono, ma dopo una lunga pausa riprendono piano, insieme all'arpa. Il giovane Arach emerge allora alla vista e spinge via un masso, poi un altro, poi un altro ancora. Va avanti così finché l'Arach non si ritrova in cima a una montagna di metallo scavata nella roccia, con la mano tesa verso la luna. Quando quasi la tocca, il sipario si chiude e la musica si ferma.

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	The Arachi in the audience rub two of their legs together, as if clapping at the end of the performance. Shortly after, some get up, heading to the exit as the doors open up once again. At the same time, more patrons are coming in to fill the vacant seats. "Interested in only some of the plays, some patrons are, so only for those they wish to see, they stay," Matlub explains. "Leave after any of the performances, you may, if someplace else, you must be, but remain for the rest of the show, I will."|100|0
units.english: The Arachi in the audience rub two of their legs together, as if clapping at the end of the performance. Shortly after, some get up, heading to the exit as the doors open up once again. At the same time, more patrons are coming in to fill the vacant seats. "Interested in only some of the plays, some patrons are, so only for those they wish to see, they stay," Matlub explains. "Leave after any of the performances, you may, if someplace else, you must be, but remain for the rest of the show, I will."
units.italian: Gli Arachi del pubblico strofinano due zampe l'una contro l'altra, come per applaudire alla fine dello spettacolo. Poco dopo alcuni si alzano e si dirigono verso l'uscita, mentre le porte si riaprono. Nello stesso tempo altri patroni entrano per occupare i posti rimasti vuoti. "Interessati solo ad alcune opere, alcuni patroni sono, quindi solo per quelle che vogliono vedere, restano", spiega Matlub. "Andare via dopo qualsiasi esecuzione, potete, se altrove dovete essere, ma restare per il resto dello spettacolo, io lo farò."

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	(Stay for the next play.)|102|0
units.english: (Stay for the next play.)
units.italian: (Resta per il prossimo spettacolo.)

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	(Leave.)|103|0
units.english: (Leave.)
units.italian: (Vai via.)

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	Once everyone is seated, the same Arach from before goes to the stage again. "A surprise for you, tonight we have. A brand new play, an anonymous group of patrons commissioned. As a critique of one of the issues that persist in our society, described it is. For our second play: Babbling Bebliss."|105|0
units.english: Once everyone is seated, the same Arach from before goes to the stage again. "A surprise for you, tonight we have. A brand new play, an anonymous group of patrons commissioned. As a critique of one of the issues that persist in our society, described it is. For our second play: Babbling Bebliss."
units.italian: Quando tutti sono seduti, lo stesso Arach di prima torna sul palco. "Una sorpresa per voi, stasera abbiamo. Un'opera nuovissima, commissionata da un gruppo anonimo di patroni. Una critica a una delle questioni che ancora permangono nella nostra società, descritta è. Per la nostra seconda opera: Bebliss Balbettante."

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	As he leaves, the curtains open to a set of an Arach street, where a child is purchasing some form of candy. From behind a building in the set, an Arach wearing tall, blue and white "socks" emerges as trumpets and tubas start playing an obnoxious track. He runs for the child and knocks the candy to the ground as he makes some gargling sound. Matlub sighs, saying, "Gibberish, it is. Nonsense, and words best left untranslated." The Arach actor goes on to cling to the walls of the building and grab things from inside the candy shop, throwing them wildly. By now, many well-dressed patrons, most likely members of House Bebliss, are getting up and leaving the theater. Meanwhile, a group of Arachi on one of the balconies doesn't even try to muffle their laughter.|106|0

The Arach actor goes on to cling to the walls of the building and grab things from inside the candy shop, throwing them wildly. By now, many well-dressed patrons, most likely members of House Bebliss, are getting up and leaving the theater. units.italian: Mentre esce, il sipario si apre su una scenografia di strada Arach, dove un piccolo sta comprando una specie di dolciume. Da dietro un edificio della scena emerge un Arach che indossa alti "calzini" blu e bianchi, mentre trombe e tube attaccano un motivo fastidioso. Corre verso il piccolo e gli fa cadere i dolci a terra emettendo una specie di gorgoglio. Matlub sospira: "Un garbuglio, è. Insensatezze, e parole che è meglio non tradurre." L'attore Arach continua aggrappandosi alle pareti dell'edificio e prendendo cose dalla bottega di dolci, gettandole all'impazzata. Ormai molti patroni ben vestiti, probabilmente membri di Casa Bebliss, si alzano e lasciano il teatro. Nel frattempo un gruppo di Arach su una delle balconate non cerca nemmeno di soffocare le risate.

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	The scene continues as a couple comes to the set, walking down the street. As they're about to lean in for what looks like a kiss, the Arach leaps from the building, landing on the bachelor with a thud. He steals the kiss, as the tubas and trumpets blast as loudly as they can. After a while, the authorities show up, only for the Arach to make a run for it down the street. The orchestra plays a tune that is as uncoordinated as his movements, and the curtains close. Not many in the audience manifest themselves, most sighing or getting ready to leave, save for the group that was laughing earlier who are now very vocal in announcing their appreciation for the play. "Know of subtlety, House Chamgar does not," Matlub says. "A shame it is, that tainted the soiree with this rivalry, they have."|107|0
units.english: The scene continues as a couple comes to the set, walking down the street. As they're about to lean in for what looks like a kiss, the Arach leaps from the building, landing on the bachelor with a thud. He steals the kiss, as the tubas and trumpets blast as loudly as they can. After a while, the authorities show up, only for the Arach to make a run for it down the street. The orchestra plays a tune that is as uncoordinated as his movements, and the curtains close. Not many in the audience manifest themselves, most sighing or getting ready to leave, save for the group that was laughing earlier who are now very vocal in announcing their appreciation for the play. "Know of subtlety, House Chamgar does not," Matlub says. "A shame it is, that tainted the soiree with this rivalry, they have."
units.italian: La scena continua con una coppia che arriva in scena camminando lungo la strada. Mentre stanno per chinarsi in quello che sembra un bacio, l'Arach salta dall'edificio e atterra sul giovanotto con un tonfo. Ruba il bacio, mentre tube e trombe soffiano con tutta la loro forza. Dopo un po' arrivano le autorità, e l'Arach se la dà a gambe lungo la strada. L'orchestra suona un motivo tanto scoordinato quanto i suoi movimenti, e il sipario si chiude. Non molti in platea si esprimono: quasi tutti sospirano o si preparano ad andarsene, tranne il gruppo che rideva prima, che ora proclama a voce alta il proprio apprezzamento. "Di sottigliezza, Casa Chamgar non ne ha", dice Matlub. "Un peccato, è, che abbiano sporcato la serata con questa rivalità."

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	The doors open once again as new patrons cycle in to watch the third play.|108|0
units.english: The doors open once again as new patrons cycle in to watch the third play.
units.italian: Le porte si riaprono mentre nuovi patroni entrano per la terza opera.

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	Everyone takes their seats, and the Arach announcer heads to the stage again. "A cathartic tragedy, our third play of this evening is. For our next performance: 'Til Death."|113|0
units.english: Everyone takes their seats, and the Arach announcer heads to the stage again. "A cathartic tragedy, our third play of this evening is. For our next performance: 'Til Death."
units.italian: Tutti prendono posto e l'annunciatore Arach torna sul palco. "Una tragedia catartica, la nostra terza opera di questa sera è. Per la prossima rappresentazione: Fino alla Morte."

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	The stage lights go dark as the curtains open to a single spotlight. It illuminates an old Arach getting dressed inside a small shack on the right side of the stage. He coughs, and something akin to an organ begins to play a melancholic melody. Once he leaves, the shack is left in the dark as the spotlight follows him to the middle of the stage, where he makes his way carefully down an empty street. He is allowed to pass beyond the spotlight, which goes dark as the perspective shifts and a second spotlight renews the focus. The left side of the stage is finally lit up, where the Arach starts tending to a garden by the entrance of a manor. The organ stops its weeping every once in a while, right when the Arach is coughing, only to resume once he's done. Leaving the manor, a richly dressed Arach points to one of the flowers in the garden, showing it to be shriveled and dead. He plucks it and throws it to the ground before leaving. The gardener picks up the flower, sticks it inside his clothes, and continues his work.|114|0

units.italian: Le luci del palco si spengono mentre il sipario si apre su un solo riflettore, che illumina un vecchio Arach che si veste dentro una piccola baracca sul lato destro della scena. Tossisce, e qualcosa di simile a un organo comincia a suonare una melodia malinconica. Quando esce, la baracca resta al buio e il riflettore lo segue al centro del palco, dove percorre con cautela una strada vuota. Gli è consentito oltrepassare il riflettore, che si spegne mentre la prospettiva cambia e un secondo riflettore rinnova la messa a fuoco. Il lato sinistro del palco si illumina finalmente: lì l'Arach comincia a curare un giardino davanti all'ingresso di una villa. L'organo interrompe il suo pianto ogni tanto, proprio quando l'Arach tossisce, per riprendere appena ha finito. Uscendo dalla villa, un Arach vestito con ricchezza indica uno dei fiori del giardino, mostrando che è avvizzito e morto. Lo coglie, lo getta a terra e se ne va. Il giardiniere raccoglie il fiore, se lo infila nei vestiti e riprende il suo lavoro.

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	Once his work is done, he heads back to his shack, the spotlights following him as he moves around the stage. Once inside, he looks inside a small box, taking a simple vase and placing the flower inside it. The stage goes dark as he goes to sleep and the piano stops, with only the occasional cough echoing throughout the theater. When the light comes to the shack again, the Arach slowly gets up and again leaves for his job, pausing for a moment on the street part of the stage during a heavy coughing fit. Once he's done with the work and begins going back home, he starts coughing again, not letting up for more than a second at a time. During this the spotlights transition to the next section of the stage, and the piano plays a brief note. Once inside his shack, he collapses, knocking down the flower vase in the process. The piano plays a few slow chords, and the last spotlight goes out during the final note.|115|0

units.italian: Finito il lavoro, torna alla sua baracca, e i riflettori lo seguono mentre si muove per il palco. Una volta dentro, fruga in una piccola cassetta, prende un vaso semplice e ci mette il fiore. Il palco si oscura mentre si corica e il pianoforte tace; solo qualche colpo di tosse riecheggia nel teatro. Quando la luce torna sulla baracca, l'Arach si alza lentamente ed esce di nuovo per il suo lavoro, fermandosi un momento nella parte del palco che è la strada durante un accesso di tosse violento. Finito il lavoro, mentre comincia a tornare a casa, ricomincia a tossire senza tregua, senza pause di più di un secondo. Intanto i riflettori passano alla sezione successiva del palco e il pianoforte suona una breve nota. Entrato nella baracca, crolla a terra rovesciando il vaso del fiore. Il pianoforte suona qualche accordo lento e l'ultimo riflettore si spegne sull'ultima nota.

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	You hear the curtains closing, and the lights of the theater turn back on again as the audience is taken by a round of applause. Once they've settled, the announcer goes up to the stage again. "And with that, concluded, our soiree is. Thank you all for gracing us with your presence, I, in name of the theater, do." He lowers his head in a bow and leaves the stage again as nearly all of the patrons in the audience get up and head for the exit, this time with nobody else coming in to take their seats. At the same time, the orchestra starts packing up their instruments. There are, however, a few who remain in their seats, including Matlub.|116|0
units.english: You hear the curtains closing, and the lights of the theater turn back on again as the audience is taken by a round of applause. Once they've settled, the announcer goes up to the stage again. "And with that, concluded, our soiree is. Thank you all for gracing us with your presence, I, in name of the theater, do." He lowers his head in a bow and leaves the stage again as nearly all of the patrons in the audience get up and head for the exit, this time with nobody else coming in to take their seats. At the same time, the orchestra starts packing up their instruments. There are, however, a few who remain in their seats, including Matlub.
units.italian: Sentite il sipario che si chiude e le luci del teatro si riaccendono mentre il pubblico è preso da un applauso. Quando si calma, l'annunciatore sale di nuovo sul palco. "E con questo, conclusa, la nostra serata è. Ringraziarvi tutti per averci onorato della vostra presenza, io, a nome del teatro, voglio." Abbassa il capo in un inchino e lascia il palco mentre quasi tutti i patroni in sala si alzano e si dirigono verso l'uscita; questa volta nessuno entra a occupare i posti. Nello stesso tempo l'orchestra comincia a riporre gli strumenti. Alcuni, però, restano seduti, compresa Matlub.

units.italian: (Resta.)

units.italian: (Vai via.)

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	You thank Matlub for inviting you here, and while she doesn't seem to pay you much mind, you can feel the gazes of other Arach patrons on you, whispering among themselves as you leave.|122|0
units.english: You thank Matlub for inviting you here, and while she doesn't seem to pay you much mind, you can feel the gazes of other Arach patrons on you, whispering among themselves as you leave.
units.italian: Ringraziate Matlub per l'invito e, anche se non sembra darvi molto peso, sentite gli sguardi degli altri patroni Arach su di voi, che sussurrano fra loro mentre ve ne andate.

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	The theater workers leave one after the other, leaving you and the other guests with an empty stage. After a while, the lights are turned off. A couple minutes later, however, you hear the curtains open, as some violins start to play in unison. Their music doesn't come from where the orchestra was seated, but as if they were all over the theater, behind you and even up on the balconies. A strong light comes from the stage, most of it blocked by a tall, dark figure. It isn't an actor, however, instead seeming to be made out of wooden parts kept up by thin wires you can barely spot when looking at the top of the stage. The violins' song is disrupted by dull, successive drum hits, at which point the figure moves, with its "arms" opening to the sides; it becomes even taller as it stands up. It is a humanoid creature, and it begins to slowly move around the stage, as if dancing in a pendulum. Cellos join in with the violin screams, and are followed by a choir, though you cannot understand their words. You do recognize, however, that it isn't being sung in any language of the Coalition.|127|0
units.english: The theater workers leave one after the other, leaving you and the other guests with an empty stage. After a while, the lights are turned off. A couple minutes later, however, you hear the curtains open, as some violins start to play in unison. Their music doesn't come from where the orchestra was seated, but as if they were all over the theater, behind you and even up on the balconies. A strong light comes from the stage, most of it blocked by a tall, dark figure. It isn't an actor, however, instead seeming to be made out of wooden parts kept up by thin wires you can barely spot when looking at the top of the stage. The violins' song is disrupted by dull, successive drum hits, at which point the figure moves, with its "arms" opening to the sides; it becomes even taller as it stands up. It is a humanoid creature, and it begins to slowly move around the stage, as if dancing in a pendulum. Cellos join in with the violin screams, and are followed by a choir, though you cannot understand their words. You do recognize, however, that it isn't being sung in any language of the Coalition.
units.italian: I tecnici del teatro escono uno dopo l'altro, lasciando voi e gli altri ospiti davanti a un palco vuoto. Dopo un po' le luci si spengono. Un paio di minuti più tardi, però, sentite il sipario che si apre, mentre alcuni violini cominciano a suonare all'unisono. La loro musica non viene da dove era seduta l'orchestra, ma come se fosse diffusa in tutto il teatro, dietro di voi e perfino sulle balconate. Una luce forte arriva dal palco, in gran parte bloccata da un'alta figura scura. Non è un attore: sembra fatta di parti di legno tenute su da fili sottili che riuscite appena a scorgere guardando la sommità del palco. Il canto dei violini è interrotto da colpi di tamburo sordi e successivi, e a quel punto la figura si muove, con le "braccia" che si aprono ai lati; diventa ancora più alta mentre si alza in piedi. È una creatura umanoide, e comincia a muoversi lentamente per il palco, come se danzasse su un pendolo. I violoncelli si uniscono alle urla dei violini e poi entra un coro, le cui parole non riuscite a capire. Riconoscete però che non sta cantando in nessuna lingua della Coalizione.

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	The creature appears to get closer to the audience, growing in size, and as the choir and instruments become more intense, it swings one of its arms upward and removes the wires. Despite this, it stays upright and continues to move. It brings both arms close and strikes its own head to form two small holes which the background light shines through. Then, it falls to its knees, with one arm reaching for the audience, as the light behind it turns off and the choir and music subside.|128|0
units.english: The creature appears to get closer to the audience, growing in size, and as the choir and instruments become more intense, it swings one of its arms upward and removes the wires. Despite this, it stays upright and continues to move. It brings both arms close and strikes its own head to form two small holes which the background light shines through. Then, it falls to its knees, with one arm reaching for the audience, as the light behind it turns off and the choir and music subside.
units.italian: La creatura sembra avvicinarsi al pubblico, crescendo di dimensioni, e mentre coro e strumenti diventano più intensi, alza un braccio e stacca i fili. Nonostante questo resta in piedi e continua a muoversi. Avvicina entrambe le braccia e colpisce la propria testa formando due piccoli fori da cui passa la luce dello sfondo. Poi cade in ginocchio, con un braccio teso verso il pubblico, mentre la luce dietro di essa si spegne e coro e musica si attenuano.

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	The lights turn back on, revealing curtains still open, but nothing on the stage. A few workers come in to tidy up the place, and the remaining guests now get up to leave. "Enjoyed the soiree, have you, Captain?" Matlub asks, as she herself gets up to leave. "Come now, actually over, the show now is."|129|0
units.english: The lights turn back on, revealing curtains still open, but nothing on the stage. A few workers come in to tidy up the place, and the remaining guests now get up to leave. "Enjoyed the soiree, have you, Captain?" Matlub asks, as she herself gets up to leave. "Come now, actually over, the show now is."
units.italian: Le luci si riaccendono e rivelano il sipario ancora aperto, ma il palco vuoto. Qualche tecnico entra per riordinare, e gli ospiti rimasti si alzano per andarsene. "La serata vi è piaciuta, Capitano?", chiede Matlub, alzandosi a sua volta per andare. "Venite, ora: davvero finito, lo spettacolo adesso è."

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	"What the hell was that thing?"|131|0
units.english: "What the hell was that thing?"
units.italian: "Che diavolo era quella cosa?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	"If it only ended now, why did that announcer come up after the third play to dismiss the guests?"|132|0
units.english: "If it only ended now, why did that announcer come up after the third play to dismiss the guests?"
units.italian: "Se è finito solo adesso, perché quell'annunciatore è salito dopo la terza opera per congedare gli ospiti?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Folklore: Arach|	She doesn't answer, heading straight for the exit. You follow her outside, and she guides you back to your ship. "Thankful for you accompanying me, I am, Captain. Safe travels, may you have."|133|0
units.english: She doesn't answer, heading straight for the exit. You follow her outside, and she guides you back to your ship. "Thankful for you accompanying me, I am, Captain. Safe travels, may you have."
units.italian: Non risponde e si dirige dritta verso l'uscita. La seguite fuori e lei vi guida di nuovo alla vostra nave. "Grata che mi abbiate accompagnata, io sono, Capitano. Buon viaggio, possiate avere."
